Moves a playing channel between the left and the right speaker. It can be called at any time while the sound plays.

```blitzbasic
; MakeBeep writes beep.wav, see the LoadSound example for the code.
Local snd = LoadSound("beep.wav")
LoopSound snd
Local ch = PlaySound(snd)
For i = 0 To 100
	ChannelPan ch, Sin(i * 7.2)
	Delay 30
Next
StopChannel ch
```
@param channel  A channel handle from [PlaySound](PlaySound) or [PlayMusic](PlayMusic).
@param pan      -1 is only left, 0 the middle and 1 only right. Values outside that range are limited to it.
@gap Panning is done by turning down the opposite speaker, so the sound does not get louder when it is panned to one side.
